title: Layer 2 round 2 minor SE: the local ref query's refname:short renders heads/<name> on a branch-tag name collision — a false off-grammar finding (plausible, pending reproduction)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in a49206fe: both for-each-ref queries now use --format=%(refname) and normalize_ref_lines strips refs/heads/ structurally on the local half — the short form's tag-disambiguation ambiguity is gone by construction, so a branch-tag name collision can no longer forge heads/<name> into the membership set. The origin/x survival property is preserved (refs/heads/origin/x strips exactly its namespace) and the normalizer tests updated to the full-refname contract. The finding was PLAUSIBLE pending reproduction; the fix removes the mechanism either way.
